fields.BDescription:
Greatshield Training
Cost: 100
Requirements: You must be proficient with shields.
You gain proficiency with Greatshields.

Secondary Stat Training
Cost: 200
Requirements: -
You gain a +1 bonus to Fitness, Cunning, Reason, Awareness or Presence.
This breakthrough can be selected multiple times. The effects stack.
fields.Proficiencies:
Human
You gain +1 in the main stat of your choice and +1 in the substat of your choice.
You gain +5 skill points in any non-crafting or gathering skill of your choice.
You can speak, read and write Common, as well as another Language of your choice. You also gain proficiency in one common weapon group.
Chosen Extra Language: Sorthen
Chosen Common Weapon Group: Longsword

Fighter (Tier 1)
Roles: Striker, Defender
Heart: You gain +1 Fitness.
Soul: You gain +1 to Power, Focus, Agility or Toughness.
Skills: You gain +5 skill points to spend on Athletics, Riding, Intimidation, Perception or Common Knowledge. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills.
Key Ability: Fighter's Journey

Guardian (Tier 2)
Roles: Defender
Heart: You gain +1 Fitness.
Soul: You gain +1 Toughness.
Skills: You gain +5 skill points to spend in Athletics, Riding, Intimidation, Perception or Common Knowledge. You can exchange any skill point for 2 expertise points, but must spend them in these skills.
Key Ability: Controlled Opportunities

Resolved Class Benefits
Fighter: Longsword proficiency.
Fighter: Small Weapons proficiency.
Fighter: Polearms proficiency.
Fighter: Light Swords proficiency.
Fighter: Dueling Weapons proficiency.
Fighter: +1 Toughness from Soul.
Fighter class: Athletics +5 skill

Starting Funds
Base Clim: 3000
Breakthrough Bonus: 0
Equipment Cost: 2890
Remaining Clim: 110

Armor (Medium)
Equipment | Armor | 1000 Clim | 2
Increases your Guard by 2 and your Block by 8, but reduces your Initiative by 2 and your Evasion and Dodge by 4.
Mods:
A mods:Weak Point Protection (20 Points): Pinpoint attacks against you reduce 1 less guard.

B mods:Chain Links (25 points): Increases the block gained from this armor by 4.
Flexible Armor (50 points): When you take the Dodge action, your next Block gains a +8 bonus. When you take the Block action, your next Dodge action gains a +4 bonus. Lasts until the start of your next turn. Can activate multiple times per turn, but does not stack.

Frame mods:Berserker Armor (10 points): This armor reduces your RP by 2, but does not reduce your evasion and dodge.

Shield (Great)
Equipment | 1000 Clim | 2
Gives a +1 Shield bonus to your guard, but a -1 penalty to your Initiative and a -2 penalty to your Evasion and Dodge. When taking the Block action, this Shield bonus is increased to 8.
Mods
A mods:Spiked Shield (20 points): You may treat your shield as a One-Handed weapon. You can use it to make an attack and still gain the shield bonus.
Mirror Shield (35 points): When you are the target of a Mystic Eye ability, you may spend 1 RP to negate the effect on yourself and reflect it back to the user.

B mods:Tower Shield (50 points): The burden of this shield is increased by 1, but it now counts as Low cover for you against ranged attacks.
Shield Formation (80 points): While next to another ally with a shield or greatshield, you gain +1 Guard. (Only actual shields apply)

Longsword (One-Handed/Two-Handed)
Equipment | Weapon | 750 Clim | 1
Versatile: At the start of your turn, before you make any attacks you may choose to treat this as either a One-Handed weapon or a Two-Handed weapon. When using a longsword as a One-Handed weapon and no other weapon or shield, you may treat the longsword as a shield as well. When using it as a Two-Handed Weapon, you deal an additional 1d4 damage on a critical hit. This extra damage is not automatically maximized from rolling a critical hit, but you keep the extra damage even if the target blocked the critical hit.
Mods
A mods:Catch Pommel (10 points): When using the Longsword with one hand, once per round you can extend the range of your attack by 5ft.
War Sword (20 points): Your first basic attack made with this weapon after moving at least 20ft maximizes one damage dice of your choice instead of rolling.
Bastard Sword (35 points): You gain a +1 Armorbreaker Power bonus against targets in Heavy armor or higher.

B mods:Extended Quillons (25 points): Grants +1 to guard when out of RP.
Heavy Crossguard (25 points): You retain the Block bonus even while using the weapon with two hands, the block value increases by +4 when wielding with one hand and no other weapon or shield in your other hand.
Lange Messer (50 points): Grants +1 to guard but increases burden by +1.
Axebreaker (80 points): You gain a +2 Axebreaker Power bonus against targets wielding axes.

Adventurer's Kit
Adventuring Essentials | Kit | 100 Clim | 1
Adventuring kits contain all of the basic tools for adventuring. Included in the kit: Backpack, Flint and steel, Rope, Notebook, Pen, Compass, Bedroll, Torches, Hand Mirror.
Effect: You can use the items for their various purposes within reason. Can store up to 5 burden of Adventuring Essentials, a Northi Lantern or items included in this kit in a combat ready state for 0 burden and contains a torch/lantern holster for hands off torch/lantern use for light purposes. Cannot store kits or other burden reducing items in this combat ready state.

Military Ration
Adventuring Essentials | Basic | 40 Clim
A ready to eat meal. Grants the effects of food for rest without having to cook or prepare anything. Can be consumed during a rest to gain the effects of food (2 mana).

Typically consists of of dried meats, dried fruits and blocks of compressed grains with honey. Sometimes includes vials of sauce. Typically pressed together and then rolled in linen cloth, but higher end ones can come in wooden boxes.
If eaten during an encounter, it's a Setup action that takes 8 AP to complete.
fields.Name: Live Human Shield Warrior

quickBuild.summary:
Shield Warrior applied for Human.
Character start: Standard Play.
Built to stand in front, block attacks, and protect allies. Toughness, Fitness, armor, and a shield are prioritized.
Class plan: Fighter mastery (800 EXP), Guardian key ability (200 EXP) = 1000 EXP.
Human can use every class and item in this package; no fallback is required.
Fighter is the strongest Guardian prerequisite for a combat tank: Charge, Slam, and Defensive Flexibility all support positioning and protection, while the alternate Armorsmith route spends its mastery on crafting.
Gear package: Armor (Medium), Shield (Great), Longsword (One-Handed/Two-Handed), Adventurer's Kit, Military Ration.
Auto-equipped loadout: Armor (Medium), Shield (Great), Longsword (One-Handed/Two-Handed), Adventurer's Kit. Consumables remain carried for use.
